AnswerRequest.description:
POST /v1/invites: logged-in user accepts or declines.
Accept (`true`) or decline (`false`) an invite as the logged-in user.

BinHierarchyResource.description: A bin with its whole warehouse path, for bin pickers.

BinResource.description: A storage bin on a shelf.

CategoryResource.description: A product category. `relationships` is filled on the single-category GET.

bins.description: `{id, bin_code, bin_name, section, row, shelf}` per bin.

warehouse_uuid.description: Same id as `warehouse_id`; null when the warehouse is gone.

CorrectionResource.description: A price correction band: prices from `value_from` to `value_to` get rounded. Decimals are strings, 2 places trimmed (zero `"0"`, unset `"0.00"`).

CreateCurrencyRequest.description: New currency. `asset_type` is an ISO 4217 code.

workspace_name.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.

CreateWorkspaceRequest.description: Sign up: a new account plus its first workspace.

CurrencyCreated.description: Create response: the new row's id.

CurrencyResource.description: A currency the workspace can price in. Exactly one is the default.

DiscountGroupList.description: List response: a page, or with `?limit=` a plain list without `meta`.

DiscountRequest.description: Create needs `discount_group_id`, `name`, `active`, `discount_product_code` and `percentage`; update keeps fields left out. `percentage` is a decimal 0 to 100 (string or number).

DiscountResource.description: A supplier discount inside a discount group.

GenerateVariantsRequest.description: Create variants from option types: every given combination, at most 500.

option_types.description: 1 to 20 types: `{name, sort_order?, values: [{value, sort_order?}]}` (1 to 100 values).

relationships.description: `supplier_relation`: the supplier (relation index shape), or null when it is gone.

oneOf.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

InviteResource.description:
One settings pending-invites row (Laravel InviteResource). `invite_code` is left out: only
its hash is stored, and the link goes to the invitee alone.
A sent invite, as listed in workspace settings.

invited_by.description: Email of whoever sent the invite.

InviteStatusResponse.description:
GET /v1/invites/get-invite-status/{code} body (Laravel InviteStatusResource keys).
What an invite link points to, for the accept or sign-up screen.

new_user.description: No account uses this email yet: show the sign-up form.

LinkedProducts.description: Linked products; always empty for now.

LocationResource.description: A free-text scan label inside a warehouse.

LocationView.description: Warehouse address. `zipcode` is upper case, `""` when missing.

MessageBody.description: A short message: `ok` after an action, or what went wrong.

Meta.description: Paging details. `total` counts matches across all pages.

from.description: 1-based index of first row on this page; null when the page is empty.

bin_id_from.description: Leave out for the warehouse-level row.

bin_id_to.description: Leave out for the warehouse-level row.

MutateStockRequest.description: Add to or take from one stock row. Decimals as strings (`"2.5"`); JSON numbers also work.

Paginated_BinResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_BrandResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_CategoryResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_CorrectionResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_CurrencyResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_DiscountResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_InviteResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_LocationResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_ProductPriceHistoryRow.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_ProductResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_RowResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_SectionResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_ShelfResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_SpecialOfferResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_StockMovement.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_StockResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_Value.description: One page of results plus paging details.

Paginated_WarehouseResource.description: One page of results plus paging details.

PersonFields.description: The new person's name, login email and password.

password.description: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.

PlaceList.description: List response: every storage location of the parent, not paged.

PriceCorrectionRequest.description: Create needs `value_from` and `value_to`; update keeps fields left out. Decimals as strings (`"12.50"`); JSON numbers also work.

ProductBrandRequest.description: Create needs `name`; update keeps fields left out, null clears them.

ProductCategoryRequest.description: Create needs `name`; update keeps fields left out, null clears them.

ProductOptionValue.description: One option value of a variant, with its type.

ProductPriceHistoryRow.description: OpenAPI shape of [`history_row`]: one price change.

changed_by.description: Full name; left out when no user made the change.

ProductRequest.description: Create needs `name` and `price` (and `multi_set_product_ids` for bundles); update keeps keys left out, null clears them. Decimals as strings (`"12.50"`); JSON numbers also work.

custom_sections.description: Custom fields are not supported: an item naming a `section_id` is rejected.

multi_set_product_ids.description: Bundle parts `[{id, quantity}]`, at most 100; required for bundle types.

price.description: Net consumer price; required on create.

ProductResource.description: A product with prices, stock and embeds. Decimal columns are strings (`"12.5000"`); list rows leave `special_offers` and `child_products_from_set` empty.

default_warehouse.description: Short warehouse on lists, full warehouse on the single GET.

purchase_discount_percentage.description: 8 decimals; null without a supplier discount.

child_products_from_set.description: Bundle parts (product shape plus `quantity`, 8 decimals), single GET only.

stocks.description:
Real stock rows, then a zero row (id `fallback-<warehouse>`) for the default warehouse
and the first store when they have none.

query.description: Barcode, EAN or product id; a literal `Shift` (some scanners type it) is dropped.

id.description: Stock id, or `fallback-<warehouse id>` for a zero row.

ProductVariantRequest.description: Variant fields; `price` or `impact_on_price` is required. Update keeps keys left out, null clears them. Decimals as strings (`"12.50"`); JSON numbers also work.

ProductVariantResource.description: A product variant. Decimal columns are strings (`"12.5000"`).

RegisterRequest.description:
POST /v1/register: new account through an invite.
Create an account through an invite link.

RowCreated.description: Create response: the same id under both keys.

RowResource.description: A row inside a warehouse section.

utilization.description: Occupied bins of the row, in % (0 without bins).

SaleStatics.description: Sales figures; all zero or null until invoices exist.

SectionResource.description: A section of a warehouse: the top level of the section/row/shelf/bin grid.

SendInviteRequest.description:
POST /v1/workspace/{workspace}/invites. `team_id`: team the invitee joins on accept.
Invite someone by email, optionally straight into a team.

team_id.description: Team the invitee joins on accepting.

default_warehouse_id.description: New default warehouse of the product.

ShelfResource.description: A shelf inside a warehouse row.

SpecialOfferRequest.description: Offer fields. Keys left out keep their value; null or blank clears. Decimals as strings (`"12.50"`); JSON numbers also work.

SpecialOfferResource.description: A special offer on one product, or a rule over brands, suppliers or categories. Decimals are strings (4 places, trimmed).

StockLevelEntry.description: One entry of `warehouses` in set-stock-levels / set-stock-requirements.

maximum_stock_level.description: Required on set-stock-requirements; not below the minimum.

StockMovement.description: One row of [`movement`]: the append-only stock ledger.

location.description: `section.row.shelf` names (codes when unnamed); null without a shelf.

StorageLocationRequest.description: Attach a scan label (or a bin, which gets a label) to a record. Send `warehouse_location_id` or `bin_id`.

replace.description: Replace the parent's existing storage locations.

StorageLocationResource.description: Where a product (or other record) is kept: a warehouse scan label.

warehouse_location.description:
The scan label with its compact `warehouse`, or `{"warehouse":{"name":"N/A"}}` when
the label is gone.

TeamResource.description: A team: a named group of members sharing a set of permissions.

relationships.description: `[]` when members were not loaded, otherwise `{"users": [...]}`

TokenResponse.description: A login session: send `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

UpdateCurrencyRequest.description: Changes to a currency. Leave a field out to keep it; send null to clear it.

UserEmailResource.description:
Laravel UserEmailResource: a user embedded in another resource.
A user shown inside another record (team member, inviter, ...).

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

ValidationErrorBody.description: Validation failed. `errors` maps each field to its messages.

VariantList.description: List response: every variant, not paged.

WarehouseBinRequest.description: Create needs `bin_code`; update keeps fields left out.

meta.description: Sent only when the list was cut at the cap.

WarehouseLocationRequest.description: POST body (create and update): `location` required, `meta` optional.

WarehouseRequest.description: Create or update a warehouse. Update keeps fields left out; null clears them.

custom_sections.description: Custom fields are not supported: an item naming a `section_id` is rejected.

WarehouseResource.description: A warehouse, with its child warehouses and responsible people.

formatted_location.description: One-line address; left out when there is no location.

utilization.description: Occupied bins of the grid, in %; null without a grid.

WarehouseRowRequest.description: Create needs `row_code`, `row_name` and the three sizes; update keeps fields left out.

WarehouseSectionRequest.description: POST body for create and update (`warehouse_id`/`workspace_id` keys are ignored).

WarehouseShelfRequest.description: Create needs `shelf_code` and `shelf_level`; update keeps fields left out.
